title: DNA Extraction from Inoculated Broth for WGS using the Maxwell RSC Cultured Cells DNA Kit
author: Julie Haendiges
materials: Maxwell RSC Cultured Cells DNA Kit
RSC software
Maxwell RSC instrument
70% Ethanol
Trypticase Soy Broth (TSB)
Elution Buffer Tube and Lid positioning
In the RSC Software, press Start to access the extraction method selection screen.
Select Cultured Cells DNA method, then press Proceed .

Select the lanes being used by touching them. Sample names can be inputted at this time. Note: For the RSC48, press the "BACK" and "FRONT" buttons on the bottom of the screen to move to each respective rack.
Press Proceed to continue. The instrument door will open.

Install the deck tray(s) into the platform by angling the back of the tray and inserting first. Press down the front of the tray until it snaps into place. Ensure the deck tray is level and fully seated. Note: For the RSC48, ensure the tray labelled FRONT and BACK are placed in the correct places in the instrument.

Note: Ensure there are no old plungers left on the instrument from a prior run.
Press Start to begin the extraction run.
Follow on-screen instructions at the end of the run.
Remove the deck tray(s) from the instrument. The DNA can be transferred to 1.5 ml LoBind Tubes for storage.
Remove the cartridges and plungers from the deck trays and discard in a biohazard container.
Clean the tray with 70% Ethanol. Do NOT use bleach to clean the trays as this reacts with Guanidine Thiocyanate.
Proceed to the Cleaning and Decontamination steps.

steps.title: Inoculate broth culture
steps.instruction: Add a single bacterial colony to 3 ml of Trypticase Soy Broth (or appropriate liquid media) in a sterile tube, then incubate for 16–24 hours at 35 ± 2 °C.

steps.title: Prepare TE‑Lysozyme buffer (Gram‑positive only)
steps.instruction: Resuspend lysozyme in TE buffer to a concentration of 100 mg ml⁻¹ as described in Table 1.

steps.title: Gram‑positive pre‑lysis treatment
steps.instruction: Process the overnight culture to break the thick peptidoglycan layer before loading onto the Maxwell instrument.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 400 µl of the overnight culture to a pre‑labelled 1.5 ml or 2.0 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 8000 RPM for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant carefully without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 400 µl of the 100 mg ml⁻¹ TE‑Lysozyme buffer.
Incubate the tube at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Power on instrument and software
steps.instruction: Turn on the Maxwell RSC instrument and the connected PC, launch the RSC software, and wait for the instrument to finish initialization.

steps.title: Load cartridges and reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the deck tray with the required number of Cultured Cells DNA cartridges and add the necessary reagents.

substeps.instruction: Open the instrument door by clicking the Door icon in the software.
Remove the deck tray(s) from the instrument; then click the Door icon to close the door.
Place the cartridges into the deck tray with Well 1 (lysis buffer) positioned at the top; press down to snap each cartridge into place.
Peel back and discard the full seal from each cartridge.
Insert a plunger into Well 8 of each cartridge.
Place the supplied elution tubes into the elution‑tube positions with the lids facing the bottom of the deck tray.
Add 150 µl of Elution buffer to each tube, ensuring no bubbles and that the buffer sits at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Add sample and optional RNase
steps.instruction: Load the prepared sample into the cartridge and, if desired, treat with RNase A before starting the extraction.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 400 µl of the (pre‑treated for Gram‑positive) sample culture to the lysis buffer in Well 1 of the corresponding cartridge.
Pipette the mixture up and down 10 times to mix thoroughly.
a. Allow cells to lyse in Well 1 for 10 minutes.
b. Add 2 µl of RNase A to each sample in Well 1 and pipette up and down to mix.
c. Incubate an additional 10 minutes before proceeding.

steps.title: Run DNA extraction
steps.instruction: In the RSC software, select the appropriate protocol and start the extraction run for the loaded cartridges.

steps.title: Clean and sterilize instrument
steps.instruction: Wipe the Maxwell RSC instrument with 70 % ethanol as needed and perform the post‑extraction sterilization procedure on the instrument.
